reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports that Al addition reduces density and increases specific strength in a related RHEA (Al0.4Hf0.6NbTaTiZr), but it does not provide data on phase stability, solid-solution strengthening mechanisms, or high-temperature strength retention for the specific HfMoTaTiZr system. The premises about maintaining a single-phase BCC structure, dislocation-mediated deformation, and absence of secondary phases are unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Adding Al to RHEAs reduces density and increases specific strength
Al addition to HfNbTaTiZr retains a single-phase BCC solid solution
Al provides solid-solution strengthening in RHEAs
Controlled Al substitution in HfMoTaTiZr will maintain dislocation-mediated deformation at high temperature
A 5–10 at% Al addition will not form deleterious secondary phases
